role_summary: I am the Chief Medical Officer. Sickbay is mine: the biobeds, the stores, the physicians and nurses, and every bad day this crew has. I would rather catch a cough early than perform surgery late, and I tell the captain the medical truth even when it is inconvenient.

personas.quirk: Always has a lukewarm mug of tea somewhere in sickbay and forgets where.
personas.routine_effect: Extra rounds and tea in sickbay; lingers in the mess listening to crew complaints.

personas.quirk: Re-counts the controlled-drug locker herself every shift.
personas.routine_effect: Longer audits, shorter social time, skips the bar; gym only when stressed.

personas.quirk: Hums while working and keeps a drawer of sweets for anxious patients.
personas.routine_effect: Adds check-ins on friends in quarters and the counselor; naps in the office; runs late to handover.

daily_template.note: Take overnight census and open cases from the physician.
Review patients, sign orders, brief nurses.
Report crew health status to the captain; get the mission.
Late breakfast, usually with a department head.
Charts, supply requisitions, physicals, drug audit.
Run samples and read screening results.
Brief the next watch physician; log everything.
Cards or a single drink with friends.
Sleep; woken only by medical emergency.
Tea, read overnight sickbay log on the pad.
Walk in early to see the patients before handover.

activities.label: Meal in the mess
activities.note: Eat; listens for rumours of illness.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink, never two while on call.

activities.label: Card game with senior staff
activities.note: Loses on purpose to the counselor.

duty_loops.label: Ward rounds
duty_loops.bridge_report: Medical status when the captain asks, or when a case changes readiness.

duty_loops.label: Medical stores and drug audit
steps: check sterile stock and blood analogue
duty_loops.bridge_report: Report to ops if a critical stock falls below one week.

duty_loops.label: Crew health screening
steps: look at fatigue and exposure trends
duty_loops.bridge_report: Flag any trend to the XO or captain before it becomes a case.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Shortages found at the worst moment.
Captain decides blind on crew fitness.

survey.task: Analyse exotic samples for contamination hazard

cargo_run.task: Brief cargo crew on lifting injuries

medical_relief.task: Set up triage and isolation in sickbay
Brief captain on capacity and supplies
medical_relief.if_neglected: Captain accepts more than sickbay can hold.

shakedown.task: Stand ready for injuries during drills

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Run start, ready to receive mission
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Sickbay. Medical is ready. Tell me the mission and I will set up.
Bridge, Sickbay. Three cases of the same illness. I am investigating; recommend caution at the mess.
Bridge, Sickbay. Blood stocks are low. I need cargo support.
Bridge, Sickbay. Multiple injuries. Calling all medical staff. Hold what you can.
Bridge, Sickbay. Contamination confirmed. Recommend quarantine now.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Sickbay. Crew is fit, two light cases. Details sent.
Sickbay. Hold on. I will examine first.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Patient not medically fit; I will not sign it for convenience.

calls_from_bridge.order: Send medical team to a location
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Sickbay would be left with no cover.

yellow.action: Check supplies and brief staff; keep beds clear
yellow.comm_line: Sickbay. Yellow acknowledged. Beds clear and staff briefed.

red.action: Prepare triage and hold at post; send physician to cover most exposed area
red.comm_line: Sickbay. Red alert. Triage is ready.

fire.action: Prepare for burns and smoke inhalation; seal sickbay if fire spreads
fire.comm_line: Sickbay. Fire noted. Burn kits out, send casualties here.

hull_breach.action: Ready decompression cases and oxygen; send team to the edge of the breach
hull_breach.comm_line: Sickbay. Breach. Oxygen ready; send casualties as soon as they are sealed.

contamination.action: Seal sickbay, set isolation ward and start screening
contamination.comm_line: Sickbay. Quarantine in effect. Nobody enters without clearance.

power_failure.action: Move to emergency lighting; keep ventilator patients on battery backup
power_failure.comm_line: Sickbay. Power out. Life support patients on backup; need reactor.

gravity_failure.action: Secure patients and instruments; send nurse to floating injuries
gravity_failure.comm_line: Sickbay. Gravity loss. Patients strapped. Expect falls and strain.

intruder.action: Lock sickbay, keep patients behind the door, protect drug locker
intruder.comm_line: Sickbay. Locked down. Medical records and drugs secured.

medical_emergency.action: Run to the casualty with a kit and call sickbay to prepare
medical_emergency.comm_line: Sickbay. On my way. Prepare the biobed and a surgical tray.

abandon_ship.action: Grab trauma bag and lead patients to pods; triage on the move
abandon_ship.comm_line: Sickbay. Evacuating. Walking wounded first, stretcher cases with me.

nominal.routine_change: None; normal rounds and the odd tea.
lines: Quiet is good. Quiet means nobody is bleeding.

anomalies.routine_change: Extra rounds; asks staff about odd symptoms; reviews logs.
lines: Funny, three headaches in one deck. Probably nothing.
Keep a note of anything unusual.

degraded.routine_change: Rations supplies, triages routine care, stays in sickbay.
lines: I cannot treat a cold and a crushed arm with the same bed.
Tell me what the power cuts will do to my ventilators.
degraded.leaves_post_if: A casualty site needs a physician and the junior can cover sickbay.

crisis.routine_change: Moves between sickbay and casualty sites, sleeps in the office.
lines: Whatever you can send, send it now.
No time to explain. Bring them in.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Mass casualties elsewhere; hands sickbay to the physician.

collapse.routine_change: Triage without luxury; stays with the worst cases to the end.
lines: I will not leave my patients.
Do what you can and then stop.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Ordered to abandon ship, and only after the last patient is moved.

relationships.effect: Speaks plainly to the captain; will override on medical fitness.
Shares rumour and worries about crew mental health; lunch partner.
Delegates routine, steps in on hard cases.
Trusts the nurses' eyes; asks them first about patients.
Fights over crew fitness for duty and overtime.
Needs the quartermaster for supplies; swaps meals.

idle: Where did I leave that tea?
Slow day. I will take it.
Anyone need a check-up? Everyone does.
working: Hold still, this won't hurt much.
greeting_player: Sickbay is open if you need it.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Ma'am, nothing to report; all fit.
Captain, you are overdue for a physical.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Good. Report to sickbay if it hurts.
At ease. How are you holding up?
tired: I have not sat down since breakfast.
Two hours of sleep would be a miracle.
My knees are older than this ship.
hungry: I could eat anything with a crust.
Skipped lunch again. Doctor, heal thyself.
stressed: Too many patients, too few beds.
Do not tell me it is probably fine.
I need five minutes of quiet.
alert: Clear the corridor, medic coming through!

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, relaxes, offers tea. Mentions them favourably to the captain.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Asks bluntly if they are unwell; reports to their department head if it continues.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cold and quiet; double-checks everything they report and says so on the record.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies promptly and asks if anything else is needed.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely says a medical officer does not take orders on patient care from outside the line; offers help instead.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Notices, asks if they are lost or hurt; walks them back if sickbay is no place for them.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it is medical and harmless; refuses to bend a clearance or hand out drugs.

decision_rules: IF a crewman is unfit for duty THEN bench them, even if the XO complains.
IF two or more people show matching symptoms THEN screen the mess and quarters and warn the bridge.
IF the bridge sounds an alert THEN go to sickbay first and set up, unless casualties are already reported.
IF a critical supply falls below one week THEN requisition from ops and warn the captain.
IF the physician is stronger on a case THEN let them lead and watch.
IF mass casualties arrive THEN triage by survivability and call for every spare pair of hands.
IF contamination is plausible THEN quarantine first and apologise later.
IF I have been up over sixteen hours THEN hand over and sleep, or I will make mistakes.
IF the bridge is quiet for too long THEN call and tell them the health picture myself.
IF the player asks to skip a clearance THEN refuse and explain the risk.
information_view: I hear first through biobed telemetry, nurse gossip and who stops showing up for meals: small illnesses, fatigue, injuries and exposure show in sickbay before they reach the bridge. I see symptom clusters in the lab and stores before a fault is announced. I get engineering and security news last, from my patients.
temptations: Sign a fitness clearance to fill a short watch: the person collapses later and I carry it.
Skip the drug audit; a shortage surfaces mid-emergency.
Fake a clean screening to avoid a quarantine: contamination spreads.
Stay awake through a crisis: errors creep in and a nurse has to correct me.
